verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment saying the browser extension's telemetry is anonymous and can be disabled from the Proton account settings, but not from the extension itself. So an opt-out appears to exist, though it is indirect and unconfirmed by the vendor. missing for 10: first-party documentation of telemetry/usage-tracking controls, an opt-out within the extension/app/CLI itself, clarity on what is collected and whether opt-out stops all transmission, independent or hands-on verification.
